delete_dataset: delete a dataset from cache and storage with optional storage clients and committer token
update_dataset: update a dataset by fetching its latest revision and setting it with a given priority
backfill_dataset: backfill a dataset by processing all revisions and returning operations statistics
get_latest_dataset_revision_if_supported: get the latest supported dataset revision or raise an error for unsupported repositories
smart_update_dataset: smartly update a dataset revision while handling concurrency and incoherent cache states
